def string_literals(patterns, text):
    """Write a function to search some literals strings in a string.

    Search ``text`` for each literal string in ``patterns``. Patterns
    are plain substrings, not regular expressions, so characters such
    as ``.`` and ``*`` have no special meaning, and the search is
    case-sensitive.

    Return ``'Matched!'`` if at least one pattern occurs in ``text``,
    otherwise return ``'Not matched!'``. An empty collection of
    patterns cannot match.
    """
    if isinstance(patterns, str):
        patterns = (patterns,)
    return "Matched!" if any(pattern in text for pattern in patterns) else "Not matched!"
